name: How long does finish carpentry installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does finish carpentry installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most finish carpentry projects take anywhere from a few hours to several days, depending on the room count, level of detail, and whether painting or patching is included. Jobs with custom built-ins or multiple rooms usually take longer because careful fitting and finish work matter more than speed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small trim jobs may take a few hours, while larger projects can take several days. Custom built-ins and multi-room work usually take longer because of measuring, fitting, and finish detail.
